title: Elephant Seals Sleep 2 Hours a Day, Upside Down, While Diving

scenes.text: An elephant seal sleeps two hours a day. Mid-dive. Upside down.
Scientists strapped tiny brain monitors to wild seals in the Pacific.
They found the seals nap for about ten minutes at a time, deep underwater.
In deep sleep, they glide down. In dream sleep, they flip upside down and spiral like a falling leaf.
Then they wake up and swim back to the surface.
At sea they get about two hours a day. On land, they make up for it with over ten.

description:
Wild elephant seals sleep about two hours a day while diving, a 2023 study in Science found. They nap for around ten minutes at a time and spiral downward upside down.
Could you live on two hours of sleep?
first_comment: Could you survive on two hours of sleep a day?
